inputs.text: There’s no virtue in keeping up an appearance of US-China unity if it means putting international expectations ahead of our own people. A government answers to its citizens and families, not to a global consensus. Trump’s withdrawal from the Paris Agreement was a defense of national sovereignty and accountability—not proof that America has abandoned responsibility. Countries should make their own choices, not outsource them to international institutions.

output.main_topic: Defense of Trump’s Paris Agreement withdrawal as an exercise of national sovereignty
subtopics: Government accountability to citizens and families
output.narrative_frame: National sovereignty and accountability are framed as taking priority over international expectations.
